RSMSSB Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2025

Post Date: December 24, 2024

6:04 pm

Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB), has released a notification on official website for the recruitment of Paramedical Staff. This recruitment is for 2626 positions. RSMSSB Application Form Will start from 18 February 2025 & the candidates can apply till the 19 March 2025. Minimum age required is 21 Years & The Maximum Age Is 40 Years as on 01 January 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for RSMSSSB Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

  • For General, OBC, EWS (Creamy Layer) : ₹ 600/-
  • For SC / ST, OBC, EWS (Non-Creamy Layer) : ₹ 400/-
  • For Divyang (Handicap) : ₹ 400/-

    • Debit Card
